stem_book: How many mole of atoms are in a mole of CH₃COOH molecule? (a) 2 moles of C atoms, 4 moles of H atoms, 2 moles of O atoms (b) 1 mole of C atom, 2 moles of H atoms, 1 mole of O atom (c) 2 moles of C atoms, 3 moles of H atoms, 2 moles of O atoms (d) None of these
key: a 2 mol C, 4 mol H, 2 mol O atoms
derived: a 2 moles of C atoms, 4 moles of H atoms, 2 moles of O atoms
correct_answer: a 2 moles of C atoms, 4 moles of H atoms, 2 moles of O atoms
work: CH₃COOH = C₂H₄O₂ ⇒ per mole: 2 mol C, 4 mol H, 2 mol O
